The syllabus budgets reading at **15 pp/hr** — this is slow, devotional reading meant to be *practiced*, not skimmed. Read early enough to try each assigned discipline more than once before class.

## What to read, week by week

Every assigned reading — author, work, and exact pages — with a check-off per week. Updates live from `assets/tasks.js`; mark a week `"done"` there to check it off.

## Three "don't get caught" moments

1. **Dec 14's Nouwen (90 pp)** — the largest single reading. Pace ~15 pp/day over the last two weeks.
2. **Practices with lead time** — the 24-hr fast (Oct 5), the week-long prayer practice you begin ~Oct 26, and Lectio Divina (Nov 16) must start before class.
3. **Late Reading Responses are never accepted**, and the Rhythm of Life loses a full letter grade per day. Dec 16 and Dec 18 are hard walls.

## Books to have on hand

**Required (own):** Augustine *Confessions* (Boulding trans.) · Bonhoeffer *Life Together* · Foster *Celebration of Discipline* · Nouwen *In the Name of Jesus*.
**Recommended:** Calhoun, *Spiritual Disciplines Handbook*.
Everything else (Smith, Willard, Peterson excerpts, Thompson, Athanasius, MLK, DeYoung, etc.) is distributed in class / posted on Canvas.

> Drop class-distributed PDFs into a `readings/` folder and link them here as you collect them.
